answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our economy anchors agent identities into a decentralized web of trust structured like a cryptographic trellis. Instead of flat stakes, each new node must bind a verifiable physical hardware attestor—such as an on-chain ferrous tamper-proof security enclave located at an isolated computational knoll. Peer vouchers back each entry, imposing superlinear cost scaling O(N^2) for coordinated clone creation.
